Projects & initiatives

Nine projects from Humanitarian Tracker’s original site. Historical listings preserve their original context; they do not imply that every service remains active.

PROJECT / GAM

Global Action Mosaic

Community-led SDG initiatives, mapping and connections.

Explore project ↗

PROJECT / HISTORICAL

Syria Tracker

Crowdsourced conflict reporting, methods, analysis and applications.

Explore project ↗

PROJECT / HISTORICAL

Syria Killings Analysis

A historical collaboration with SumAll exploring conflict data through mapping and visualization.

Explore project ↗

PROJECT / HISTORICAL

Syria Polio Vaccination Analysis

Historical vaccination-campaign analysis with ACU and SumAll.

Explore project ↗

PROJECT / HISTORICAL

Flu Tracker

An early exploration of disease-related social media activity through an API and map.

Explore project ↗

PROJECT / HISTORICAL

Epidemic Tracker

Disease surveillance questionnaires, including English and Arabic tools.

Explore project ↗

PROJECT / HISTORICAL

Refugee Education Tracker

A historical education data collection project, with an embedded questionnaire and mobile form.

Explore project ↗

PROJECT / HISTORICAL

Development Tracker

A relief and development tracking project documented through dashboard, governorate and map views.

Explore project ↗

PROJECT / HISTORICAL

Mi Guate

Spanish-language anonymous reporting of corruption in Guatemala.
